articles.summary: We tested four leading LLMs using Datasaur’s Labeling Agent on a zero-shot entity recognition task. GPT-4o delivered the highest overall score for accuracy and efficiency, while other models like Gemini and Claude excelled in coverage and balance, revealing unique tradeoffs for each.
articles.title: We Tested 4 Top LLMs for Labeling. One Surprised Us.

articles.summary: This July, we’ve introduced several updates to improve both the speed and precision of your labeling workflow, whether you're reviewing documents, training models, or managing structured data. From sorting lines by metadata to letting AI lend a hand, here’s what’s new.
articles.title: July Feature Updates: Labeling Agent, Smarter Search, and Editable Rows
